skill.name: me-featured-events
skill.description: Browse and subscribe to ME News AI and Web3 events with type, region, date, and recurring reminder controls.
skill.summary: Track selected AI and Web3 events through ME News with filtered queries and reliable recurring notifications.
skill.author: me-news

security_audit.summary: The static alerts are lexical false positives caused by Markdown code spans, JavaScript template literals, fixed read-only API calls, and isolated test helpers. Two medium concerns remain: caller-controlled state paths can overwrite writable files, and imported event links are forwarded without validation.

remediation.issue: State files can be written to unrestricted caller-selected paths.
remediation.suggestion: Resolve the path under an approved workspace directory, reject paths outside it, and refuse symbolic-link destinations before writing.

remediation.issue: Imported event URLs can point to untrusted destinations.
remediation.suggestion: Allow only HTTPS links, label external destinations, and reject unsafe protocols before adding links to reminders.

semantic_findings.title: Unrestricted State Path Can Overwrite Files
semantic_findings.description: The --state argument and ME_FEATURED_EVENTS_STATE value become a write target without containment checks. A crafted path can replace any writable file with subscription state.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The state path is accepted directly and saveState renames a generated file over that destination. The risk requires an attacker or unsafe caller to control the argument or environment value.

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted Event Links Are Forwarded to Users
semantic_findings.description: Event URLs from the remote API are included in reminders without an origin or protocol check. Imported events may therefore deliver misleading or unsafe links.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The formatter appends event.url as a string, and the API reference states that activity_import entries can use spreadsheet-provided links. No scheme or host validation is present.

medium_findings.title: Unrestricted State Path Can Overwrite Files
medium_findings.description: The --state argument and ME_FEATURED_EVENTS_STATE value become a write target without containment checks. A crafted path can replace any writable file with subscription state.
medium_findings.confidence_reasoning: The state path is accepted directly and saveState renames a generated file over that destination. The risk requires an attacker or unsafe caller to control the argument or environment value.

medium_findings.title: Untrusted Event Links Are Forwarded to Users
medium_findings.description: Event URLs from the remote API are included in reminders without an origin or protocol check. Imported events may therefore deliver misleading or unsafe links.
medium_findings.confidence_reasoning: The formatter appends event.url as a string, and the API reference states that activity_import entries can use spreadsheet-provided links. No scheme or host validation is present.

content.user_title: Track AI and Web3 Events with ME News
content.value_statement: Finding relevant events across dates and regions takes repeated work. This skill filters ME News events and supports confirmed recurring reminders.
actual_capabilities: Queries upcoming events from the ME News read-only event API.
Filters events by AI or Web3 type, region, hours, or date range.
Creates a local subscription baseline without replaying older events.
Polls new events with cursor tracking, pagination, and recent-item deduplication.
Formats event names, excerpts, time ranges, locations, and returned links.
Supports daily and five-minute reminder tasks after user confirmation.
limitations: Requires Node.js 18 or newer for the bundled scripts.
Depends on the availability and accuracy of the ME News event API.
Requires an external scheduler and delivery channel for recurring reminders.
Uses Asia/Shanghai defaults and does not verify imported event links.

best_practices: Confirm event types, regions, schedule, delivery channel, and recipient before enabling reminders.
Use explicit date ranges when a month or calendar period matters.
Verify event details and external links before registration or travel.
anti_patterns: Do not create recurring tasks for a one-time event search.
Do not mark delivery successful unless the delivery tool confirms it.
Do not store channel credentials in the skill directory or state file.

faq.question: Which events can this skill find?
faq.answer: It finds AI and Web3 events available through the ME News event API.

faq.question: Can I filter events by location?
faq.answer: Yes. You can select one or more regions returned by the API.

faq.question: Can I search a specific date range?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide both start and end dates for a range of up to 366 days.

faq.question: Does a one-time search create reminders?
faq.answer: No. The skill creates reminders only after an explicit subscription request and confirmation.

faq.question: What is required for recurring notifications?
faq.answer: You need Node.js 18 or newer, a supported scheduler, and a configured delivery channel.

faq.question: How does the skill avoid missing new events?
faq.answer: It advances the event cursor only after confirmed delivery and retries messages with uncertain results.
